name: devlaunch-growth-engine
description: DevLaunch Growth Engine - Phase 1 monorepo (apps/api, apps/worker, apps/dashboard, packages/db, packages/agent-sdk, packages/embed-widget).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@devlaunch/agent-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@devlaunch/api && npm run build --workspace=@devlaunch/worker
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@devlaunch/agent-sdk --if-present && npm run test --workspace=@devlaunch/worker --if-present && npm run test --workspace=@devlaunch/api --if-present
